scripts.postinstall: node -e "var fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');var nm=path.resolve(__dirname,'node_modules','lightweight-charts','dist');var files=['lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js','lightweight-charts.standalone.development.js'];var lib=path.join(__dirname,'lib','lightweight-charts');fs.mkdirSync(lib,{recursive:true});for(var f of files){var src=path.join(nm,f);if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,path.join(lib,f));console.log('Copied '+f+' to lib/');break;}} "
